name: anistudio-2d
description: AniStudio 2D — a drag-and-drop 2D animation studio with built-in inverse kinematics.

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --linux AppImage deb rpm
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64
